provenance: post-hoc A3 follow-up to the pre-registered plan.json (sha prefix 9892ac75); written after A1's feasibility gate fired on 7/80 rules

design.transform_A3: sigma(f,r)=(n-1-f,n-1-r) applied to movement atoms, initial position, drop masks and promotion masks; type ids and flags unchanged
design.endpoint: compile status; one-ply legal-action bijection at the initial position; exact equality of normalized board/hand/promotion values and median_non_anchor_value
design.decision_rule: all 80 compile and 80/80 one-ply bijections and 0 value mismatches -> rotation_is_a_rule_isomorphism_and_profile_invariant; any compile failure -> unsupported; any bijection failure -> transform_not_a_rule_isomorphism; bijection holds but a value differs -> profile_not_a_function_of_rule_structure
design.mechanism_check: is the evaluator promotion zone (squares without empty forward mobility) invariant under sigma

nonclaims: no strength, utility or game-outcome claim
the one-ply bijection is a bounded legality check, not game-tree equivalence
one generator family, square boards 6 and 8, 40 seeds
profile invariance does not imply that the served evaluator is invariant, and the mechanism check only records the forward-zone structure
